description: TfL’s Transport Classification of Londoners groups output areas into nine segments using the 2011 Census and a TfL-specified 2015 survey. The source says travel behaviour, characteristics and attitudes support policy and scheme development. Fields include modal trip indicators and propensities to reduce car use or increase walking and cycling. The description gives a September 2016 update. These are historical area-level classifications, not current individual travel observations. Coverage is Greater London. Access is through the published ArcGIS feature service. Licence and cost: The source states UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: only item, service and layer metadata were inspected. No feature records were downloaded, and current completeness, geometric quality and operational availability remain untested. Access charges are not stated in the inspected metadata. The resource provides travel-behaviour inputs; applying it in a simulation requires checking the source limits and relevant model assumptions. Related resources include the existing TfL 2023 PTAL grid.
